text: My daily routine starts early. I usually wake up at seven o'clock and have a quick breakfast before getting ready for work. I start work at nine and follow a regular schedule with a short lunch break around noon. After work, I go to the gym three times a week because exercise helps me feel energetic. In the evening, I cook dinner, watch a little TV, or read a book. I try to go to bed before eleven. Staying consistent with my routine helps me feel organised and reduces stress.
